mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances with strong PAYEMS growth, or PAYEMS growth does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
